claims.quote: The brown dot peckoltia (Peckoltia oligospila), also known as L006, is a suckermouth catfish from the rios Tocantins and Capim in Brazil.
This species is known from the rios Tocantins and Capim in Tocantins and Pará states, Brazil including a number of their tributaries.
